full_prompt_en: A decorative folk-art landscape places a dense field of small white flowers before a long row of old town buildings. The foreground rises from a dark band of thin stems into hundreds of cream and white circular blossoms, each drawn with delicate radial marks or a tiny golden center. A pale curved hill sweeps from the left middle ground toward the right, dividing the flower field into light and dark patches. Sparse round-canopied trees stand among the flowers in charcoal, beige, slate blue, and muted mauve, their fine branch lines giving the simple disks internal texture. Across the upper third, compact houses and shops form a colorful but subdued strip of red brick, gray, cream, and faded blue. Tiny pedestrians gather along the street, and a dark tram or train runs horizontally in front of the buildings. Behind the roofs, factory chimneys send narrow black smoke into layered gray clouds. The scene is not an ordinary perspectival view; near flowers are nearly as important as the distant town, and repeated dots create a patterned surface across the whole lower half. Lines stay precise and small, with slight grain softening the otherwise flat color areas. The contrast between an abundant flowering foreground and a smoky urban skyline gives the image a quietly bittersweet tone. The whole frame reads as a carefully patterned memory of nature and industry sharing one horizon.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅装饰性民艺风景把密集的白色小花田放在一整排老城建筑前。前景从细茎组成的深色带向上长出数百朵奶油白和白色圆花，每朵都有细致的放射状笔迹或小小金色花心。一片浅色弯曲山坡从左侧中景扫向右侧，把花田分成明暗不同的区域。稀疏的圆冠树立在花间，呈炭黑、米色、石板蓝与低饱和灰紫色，纤细枝线为简洁圆盘添入内部肌理。上方三分之一处，紧凑的房屋与店铺组成一条色彩丰富但克制的长带，有砖红、灰色、奶油色和褪色蓝色。小小的行人聚在街边，深色电车或列车在建筑前水平驶过。屋顶后方，工厂烟囱把狭窄黑烟送进层叠灰云。画面不是常规透视景观；近处花朵与远处小城几乎同等重要，重复的小点让整个下半部成为有纹样的表面。线条细密准确，淡淡颗粒软化了其他地方较平整的色区。繁盛花田与烟雾城市天际线的对照，使图像带有安静而微苦的情绪。整幅画像一段经过精细纹样编织的记忆，自然与工业共享同一条地平线。
style_prompt_en: The decorative folk-art image combines a broad lower carpet of repeated tiny pale circles with a narrow, orderly band of rectilinear color above. Fine dark stems and radial lines supply intricate texture, while rounded muted tree-like forms punctuate the patterned expanse at a slower scale. Brick red, slate, cream, charcoal, beige, and gray-blue remain subdued, with small warm centers adding sparkle. A sweeping light curve divides near and far tonal zones without breaking the overall flatness. The upper edge is layered with small architectural rhythms and horizontal movement; behind it, soft gray bands and thin dark marks create atmosphere. Perspective is deliberately compressed so near pattern and distant detail coexist on one decorative plane. Slight grain softens the crisp linework. The whole frame feels patient and bittersweet, held by repetition, restrained color, and the meeting of organic dots with rigid urban geometry.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅装饰性民艺图像把下方宽阔、由重复浅色小圆组成的地毯式区域，与上方狭窄而整齐的直角形色带结合起来。纤细深色茎线和放射状细笔形成繁密肌理，尺度更大的低饱和圆冠形态以较慢节奏点缀纹样区域。砖红、石板色、奶油色、炭黑、米色和灰蓝始终克制，小小暖色中心带来闪光。一道横扫的浅色曲线区分近处与远处的明暗区，却没有打破整体平面感。上缘层叠细小建筑节奏和水平运动，其后柔软灰色条带与纤细深线形成氛围。透视有意压缩，使近处纹样和远方细节共存于一个装饰平面。微弱颗粒柔化清晰线描。整幅画由重复、克制色彩，以及有机圆点与刚性城市几何的相遇支撑，显得耐心而带一点忧伤。
theme_en: A field of white flowers before an old industrial town
theme_zh: 老工业城前的一片白花田
name: Jo Grundy
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
